SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    customers.tags IS NULL AS "customers.tags_missing"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    customers.tags IS NULL
), _cm_customers__tags__value_count_distinct AS (
  SELECT
    tags.tags IS NULL AS "__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.grain_00c1034a",
    tags.id AS "__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.tags.id",
    COUNT(DISTINCT __slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value) AS "__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value_count_distinct"
  FROM customers AS tags
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      __slayer_u.value
    FROM UNNEST(tags.tags) AS __slayer_u(value)
    WHERE
      __slayer_u.value IS NOT NULL
  ) AS __slayer_list__9_customers__tags
  GROUP BY
    tags.tags IS NULL,
    tags.id
), __slayer_stage_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tags_missing" AS "tags_missing",
    _stage_inner."customers.n_tags" AS "n_tags"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.tags_missing",
      COALESCE(
        _cm_customers__tags__value_count_distinct."__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value_count_distinct",
        0
      ) AS "customers.n_tags"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__tags__value_count_distinct
      ON _base_2."customers.tags_missing" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__tags__value_count_distinct."__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.grain_00c1034a"
      AND _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__tags__value_count_distinct."__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.tags.id"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN per_cust.tags_missing THEN NULL ELSE per_cust.n_tags END AS "per_cust.tag_count",
  COUNT(*) AS "per_cust.customers"
FROM __slayer_stage_per_cust AS per_cust
GROUP BY
  CASE WHEN per_cust.tags_missing THEN NULL ELSE per_cust.n_tags END
ORDER BY
  "per_cust.tag_count" ASC
LIMIT 21
